shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd; if [ -f round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' round-brief.md; else echo 'NO_ROUND_BRIEF'; fi; sed -n '1,240p' ticket.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md; printf '\\n--- status ---\\n'; git status --short --branch; printf '\\n--- test commands ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml; printf '\\n--- package ---\\n'; sed -n '1,180p' package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git log -4 --oneline; printf '\\n--- acceptance ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts; printf '\\n--- validation ---\\n'; sed -n '1,180p' src/transport/ws/validation.ts; printf '\\n--- test ---\\n'; sed -n '1,100p' src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts; printf '\\n--- specs anchors ---\\n'; rg -n \"list_sessions|session_list|list_conversations|conversation_list|Status|validated by\" specs src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/transport/ws/validation.ts | sed -n '1,150p'; nl -ba specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md | sed -n '155,205p'; git diff HEAD~1 -- src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md .lore/dod.md; if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check; git diff --stat; git diff -- src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md .lore/dod.md; printf '\\n--- status ---\\n'; git status --short --branch"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts && git commit -m "fix websocket conversation list validation"'
